remarks: Good credit is required. No pets allowed. Spacious and bright end unit townhouse featuring an updated eat in kitchen with a newer range, refrigerator, and dishwasher, along with beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The first floor offers a large living room with sliding doors leading to a balcony, a half bath, and a generous dining room. The second floor includes a primary suite with a remodeled full bath and three large closets, along with two additional spacious bedrooms and a newly updated full bath. The finished lower level provides a laundry room and access to a one car garage. The unit also offers ample closet space, one reserved parking spot, and guest parking. Community amenities include an in ground pool. Conveniently located near Downtown Stamford, Ridgeway, shopping, restaurants, transportation, parks, and so much more!
